title: herdr-plugin-workspace-manager config
description: Declarative herdr tab/pane layouts with per-workspace defaults. Keep in sync with src/config.rs.

workspaces.description: Map a repo (or worktree path) to a default layout.

id.description: Unique layout id, referenced by workspaces[].defaultLayout.

env.description: Environment variables applied to every pane in this layout. A pane's own `env` wins on conflict.

tabs.description: Tabs, walked in order. The first tab replaces the worktree's existing tab.

env.description: Environment variables for the pane process. Values are stringified, so `PORT: 3000` needs no quotes.

setup.description: Optional one-off command run on the single setup:true pane before the rest of the layout.

command.description: Command to run on the setup:true pane (e.g. "npm install").

blocking.description: If true, no further tabs/panes spawn until the setup command finishes.

panes.description: Panes in this tab. The first is the tab's root pane; each later pane splits from the previous one.

not.$comment: ratio and size are mutually exclusive.

command.description: Optional command to run in the pane. It runs in your own interactive login shell, so shell rc setup (mise/asdf/nvm, aliases, PATH) applies. Mutually exclusive with `agent`.

persist.description: Keep the pane at a shell prompt after `command` exits. Set false to let the pane close with the command. Requires `command`.

env.description: Environment variables for this pane, merged over the layout's `env`.

agent.description: Start a recognized coding agent in this pane with `herdr agent start`, which returns only once herdr detects the agent is ready for input. Mutually exclusive with `command`.

agentName.description: Stable alias for the agent, usable with `herdr agent ...` afterwards. Must be unique among live agents. Defaults to a name derived from the kind and workspace.

agentArgs.description: Arguments passed through to the agent's own executable (after `--`).

prompt.description: Prompt submitted to the agent once it is ready. Submitted and left running unless `promptTimeoutMs` is set.

agentTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the agent to become ready. herdr requires >3000 and <=300000.

promptTimeoutMs.description: Setting this makes the apply wait for the agent to settle (idle or done) after `prompt`, up to this long. Omit to submit the prompt and move on.

setup.description: Marks the single pane that runs the layout's setup.command (at most one per layout).

split.description: For panes after the first: split direction relative to the previous pane. vertical=side by side (right), horizontal=stacked (down).

ratio.description: Legacy split ratio between 0 and 1: the fraction of the split the PREVIOUS pane keeps (this pane gets the rest). Prefer `size`, which sizes this pane directly. Mutually exclusive with `size`.

size.description: Size of THIS pane along the split axis (columns for a vertical/right split, rows for a horizontal/down split). A whole number is fixed cells (e.g. 40); a number between 0 and 1 is a fraction (0.3 = 30%); a string like "30%" is a percentage. Fixed cell sizes are converted to a ratio against the tab's cell area. Mutually exclusive with `ratio`.

workspace.description: Needs `repo` and/or `path`. A repo match wins over a path match.

repo.description: Repo root (~ expanded) or bare repo name. Matches any linked worktree of that repo; the main checkout is never touched.

path.description: Prefix-match the worktree's checkout path (more brittle than repo).

defaultLayout.description: Layout id applied to a matching new worktree when no layoutMatching rule matches its branch.

layoutMatching.description: Ordered branch-pattern rules. The first rule whose worktreePattern matches the new worktree's branch wins; if none match, defaultLayout applies.

matchRule.description: Apply `layout` when the new worktree's branch matches `worktreePattern`.

title.description: Optional label for this rule (documentation only).

worktreePattern.description: Glob matched (full-string) against the new worktree's branch name. * = any characters, ? = a single character. e.g. "fix/rwr-*".

layout.description: Layout id applied when this pattern matches the branch.
